correctness.rationale: Clausen quadratic identity gives exact coefficient expansion with last term a_n*C(2n,n) of ν₂=3s₂(n). Every earlier term k=n-j has ν₂≥4j+3s₂(k)>3s₂(n) from s₂(n)≤s₂(k)+j. The unique least 2-adic term determines the sum. Legendre gives ν₂(C(3n,n))=2s₂(n)-s₂(3n); Guo establishes integrality of the normalized quotient. Standalone exact integer computations for n≤240 confirm all identities.
